newsitem.title: USA: Tesoro chairman sees steady earnings growth.
newsitem.headline: Tesoro chairman sees steady earnings growth.

text.p: Tesoro Petroleum Corp chairman Bruce Smith on Wednesday said he expects a steady growth in earnings to continue over the next two years.
Analysts expect the company to generate a mean $0.26 a share earnings in the second quarter, $0.99 a share earnings for fiscal 1997 and $1.26 a share earnings in fiscal 1998, according to First Call.
"I think those numbers are good," Smith said.
Speaking at the company's annual meeting here, Smith said the company's stock remains undervalued by Wall Street despite the forecasts of improved earnings through 1998.
The company on Monday reported $0.23 a share earnings for the first quarter and posted its fourth consecutive year of higher earnings in 1996.
"As you start to record improvements like that, the market will adjust your value," Smith said. "We are on more solid financial ground than most of our peers."
